enum.name: FAULT_ACTION
enum.description: Action requested by an FAULT fault command.

entry.name: FAULT_ACTION_SET
entry.description: Create or replace one fault definition.

entry.name: FAULT_ACTION_CLEAR
entry.description: Clear the specified fault definition.

entry.name: FAULT_ACTION_CLEAR_ALL
entry.description: Clear all FAULT fault definitions.

entry.name: FAULT_ACTION_QUERY
entry.description: Request the current status of the specified fault.

enum.name: FAULT_TARGET
enum.description: PX4 subsystem or data path targeted by an FAULT fault.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_NONE
entry.description: No flight-system target. Used for infrastructure tests.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_IMU
entry.description: The effective IMU information channel supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_MAG
entry.description: Effective three-axis magnetometer estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_GNSS
entry.description: Effective GNSS position or velocity measurement supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_DOWNWARD_RANGE
entry.description: Selected downward-facing range measurement supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_BAROMETER
entry.description: Barometric altitude measurement supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_TARGET_MOTOR
entry.description: Allocated normalized motor commands supplied to the common PX4 actuator-output path.

enum.name: FAULT_MODE
enum.description: Transformation applied by an FAULT fault.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_NO_EFFECT
entry.description: Infrastructure-only fault that does not modify flight data or commands.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_ACCEL_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant acceleration bias vector in m/s^2 to the effective IMU estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_ACCEL_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white acceleration noise with per-axis standard deviation in m/s^2 to the effective IMU estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_GYRO_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant body-frame angular-rate bias vector in rad/s to the effective IMU estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_GYRO_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white angular-rate noise with per-axis standard deviation in rad/s to the effective IMU estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_MAG_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant body-frame three-axis magnetic-field bias vector in Gauss to the effective magnetometer estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_MAG_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white magnetometer noise with per-axis standard deviation in Gauss to the effective estimator input.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_GNSS_POSITION_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant unreported NED position offset in metres to the effective GNSS estimator input while preserving receiver health and accuracy metadata.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_GNSS_POSITION_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white NED position noise with per-axis standard deviation in metres to the effective GNSS estimator input while preserving receiver health and accuracy metadata.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_GNSS_VELOCITY_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant unreported NED velocity offset in metres per second to the effective GNSS estimator input while preserving receiver health, validity and accuracy metadata.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_GNSS_VELOCITY_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white NED velocity noise with per-axis standard deviation in metres per second to the effective GNSS estimator input while preserving receiver health, validity and accuracy metadata.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_DOWNWARD_RANGE_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant unreported scalar offset in metres to the selected downward-facing range measurement supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_DOWNWARD_RANGE_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white noise with scalar standard deviation in metres to a detected downward-facing range measurement.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_DOWNWARD_RANGE_DEGRADATION
entry.description: Reduce the effective maximum detection distance of the downward-facing range sensor. The scalar parameter is the effective maximum distance in metres.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_BARO_ALTITUDE_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant unreported scalar offset in metres to the barometric altitude supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_BARO_ALTITUDE_NOISE
entry.description: Add deterministic zero-mean Gaussian white noise with scalar standard deviation in metres to the barometric altitude supplied to the PX4 estimator.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_MOTOR_OUTPUT_BIAS
entry.description: Add a constant normalized command bias to the selected allocated motor commands before actuator output conversion.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_MOTOR_OUTPUT_DELAY
entry.description: Use an older allocated motor command for selected motors. delay_us is the requested command age.

entry.name: FAULT_MODE_MOTOR_MAX_OUTPUT_DEGRADATION
entry.description: Cap selected motor commands at a reduced absolute normalized maximum. scalar is the cap in [0, 1).

enum.name: FAULT_RESULT
enum.description: Result of processing an FAULT fault command.

entry.name: FAULT_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: The command was accepted.

entry.name: FAULT_RESULT_REJECTED
entry.description: The command was rejected.

entry.name: FAULT_RESULT_DUPLICATE
entry.description: The command sequence had already been processed.

entry.name: FAULT_RESULT_NOT_FOUND
entry.description: The requested fault definition was not found.

entry.name: FAULT_RESULT_INTERNAL_ERROR
entry.description: The command could not be processed because of an internal error.

enum.name: FAULT_REASON
enum.description: Detailed reason associated with an FAULT fault acknowledgement.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_NONE
entry.description: No rejection or error reason.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_DISABLED
entry.description: FAULT fault injection is disabled.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_ARMED_NOT_ALLOWED
entry.description: Fault configuration is not permitted while the vehicle is armed.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_PROTOCOL_VERSION
entry.description: The protocol version is unsupported.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_ACTION
entry.description: The requested action is invalid.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_TARGET
entry.description: The requested fault target is unsupported.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_MODE
entry.description: The requested fault mode is unsupported.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_INSTANCE_MASK
entry.description: The target instance mask is invalid.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_AXIS_MASK
entry.description: The target axis mask is invalid.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_DURATION
entry.description: The requested duration is invalid or exceeds the configured limit.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_NO_FREE_SLOT
entry.description: No fault storage slot is available.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_UNKNOWN_FAULT_ID
entry.description: The requested fault identifier does not exist.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_DUPLICATE_SEQUENCE
entry.description: The command sequence has already been processed.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_INVALID_PARAMETER
entry.description: A target/mode-specific scalar, vector, delay, or other effect parameter is invalid.

entry.name: FAULT_REASON_DUPLICATE_FAULT_ID
entry.description: The scenario-local fault identifier is already used by a different target/mode object.

enum.name: FAULT_STATE
enum.description: Current lifecycle state of an FAULT fault definition.

entry.name: FAULT_STATE_EMPTY
entry.description: No fault definition occupies the slot.

entry.name: FAULT_STATE_PENDING
entry.description: The fault has been accepted but its activation time has not arrived.

entry.name: FAULT_STATE_ACTIVE
entry.description: The fault is currently active.

entry.name: FAULT_STATE_CLEARED
entry.description: The fault was explicitly cleared.

entry.name: FAULT_STATE_EXPIRED
entry.description: The configured fault duration has elapsed.

entry.name: FAULT_STATE_REJECTED
entry.description: The fault definition was rejected.

message.name: FAULT_COMMAND
message.description: Configure, clear, or query an FAULT fault managed inside PX4. The command itself does not directly modify flight data; fault application is performed only by explicitly implemented PX4 fault hooks.
message.field: Identifier of the scenario that owns this command.
Monotonically increasing command sequence used for acknowledgement and duplicate detection.
Delay from PX4 command reception until fault activation, in milliseconds.
Requested active duration in milliseconds.
Deterministic random seed for stochastic fault modes.
Delay parameter used by future delayed-data fault modes, in microseconds.
Bitmask selecting target sensor, battery, or actuator instances.
Three-component parameter vector. Its interpretation depends on target and mode.
Scalar fault parameter. Its interpretation depends on target and mode.
Scenario-local identifier of the fault definition.
MAVLink system expected to process the command.
MAVLink component expected to process the command.
FAULT fault protocol version. The initial version is 1.
Requested fault-management action.
PX4 subsystem or data path targeted by the fault.
Fault transformation mode.
Target-specific selection mask. For vector sensors: bit0 X, bit1 Y, bit2 Z. For TARGET_MOTOR: bits0..7 select Motor1..Motor8.

message.name: FAULT_ACK
message.description: Acknowledgement generated by PX4 after processing an FAULT fault command.
message.field: PX4 hrt_absolute_time() when the acknowledgement was generated.
Scenario identifier copied from the command.
Command sequence copied from the command.
Fault identifier copied from the command.
MAVLink system to which this acknowledgement is addressed.
MAVLink component to which this acknowledgement is addressed.
FAULT fault protocol version used by PX4.
Overall command-processing result.
Detailed acceptance, rejection, or error reason.
Fault state after processing the command.

message.name: FAULT_STATUS
message.description: Current PX4-side configuration and lifecycle state of one FAULT fault definition.
message.field: PX4 hrt_absolute_time() when this status was generated.
PX4 monotonic time at which the fault becomes or became active.
PX4 monotonic time at which the fault expires.
Identifier of the scenario that owns the fault.
Sequence of the command that created or most recently updated the fault.
Number of samples or outputs actually transformed by the fault hook.
Bitmask selecting target instances.
Accepted deterministic random seed.
Accepted delay parameter in microseconds.
Accepted three-component fault parameter.
Accepted scalar fault parameter.
Scenario-local fault identifier.
MAVLink system to which this status is addressed.
MAVLink component to which this status is addressed.
FAULT fault protocol version used by PX4.
Configured PX4 subsystem or data-path target.
Configured fault mode.
Current lifecycle state.
Accepted target-specific axis or motor-selection bitmask.

message.name: FAULTED_DOWNWARD_DISTANCE
message.description: Continuous PX4 authoritative downward-distance output for the companion supervisor. Positive infinity means that no usable target is currently detected.
message.field: PX4 publication time in microseconds.
Source distance_sensor timestamp, or zero when no source has ever been observed.
Age of the most recent source sample, or zero when no source has ever been observed.
Original distance-sensor device identity.
Bias scenario identifier, or zero.
Bias SET sequence, or zero.
Noise scenario identifier, or zero.
Noise SET sequence, or zero.
Range-degradation scenario identifier, or zero.
Range-degradation SET sequence, or zero.
Latest raw source distance, or positive infinity before a source exists.
Finite detected distance after degradation, bias and noise; positive infinity when no target is detected.
Bias applied to this source sample, or zero.
Noise applied to this source sample, or zero.
Nominal minimum sensor distance.
Nominal maximum sensor distance.
Current effective maximum distance after degradation.
Original source variance.
Bias fault identifier, or zero.
Noise fault identifier, or zero.
Range-degradation fault identifier, or zero.
Original source signal quality.
Original MAV_DISTANCE_SENSOR type.
Original MAV_SENSOR_ORIENTATION value.
Publishing EKF2 instance.
Zero for valid; one no source; two stale; three non-finite; four below minimum; five above nominal maximum; six blocked by degraded range.
One after a source sample has ever been observed.
One while the latest sample is at most 100 ms old.
One when the latest raw sample is finite and within nominal limits.
One when faulted_distance_m is a usable finite detection.
One when faulted_distance_m is positive infinity.
One when the bias definition is active.
One when the noise definition is active.
One when the range-degradation definition is active.
One when bias transformed the latest available sample.
One when noise transformed the latest available sample.
One when range degradation blocked the latest nominally valid sample.
